parrafo_1.es: Danisweets305 es la reposteria casera de Daniela en Doral: marquesa, bundt cakes de chocolate, tartaletas de frutos rojos y maracuya, flan y torta de pina invertida, todo hecho a pedido.
parrafo_1.en: Danisweets305 is Daniela's home bakery in Doral: marquesa, chocolate bundt cakes, berry and passion fruit tartaletas, flan and pineapple upside-down cake, all made to order.

parrafo_2.es: Ademas de los postres, Daniela y su esposo dictan clases de pasteleria y decoracion: varias resenas hablan tanto de los postres como de lo bien que explican en las clases.
parrafo_2.en: Beyond the desserts, Daniela and her husband teach pastry and cake decorating classes: several reviews mention both the desserts and how well they explain things in class.

items.quote: Best cakes in Miami!! The marquesa is amazing!!
I tried their cakes and I absolutely loved them. They were delicious, with an incredible flavor, and you can tell the love and dedication in every detail.
I went to one of Daniela's classes and I loved it. She and her husband do a great job. My family loved all the sweets, especially the chocolate marquise with passion fruit.
